conclusion: On this VS18 Windows Release configuration, CMake --parallel limits MSBuild project jobs but does not by itself cap the GUI compiler /MP workers. A six-project build spawned 17 cl processes including the driver and reduced available RAM to about 2.3 GiB. The successful local recipe explicitly builds InlongSlicer_app_gui, InlongSlicer_profile_validator, COPY_DLLS, gettext_po_to_mo and orca_stubgen first with --parallel 1 -- /p:CL_MPCount=6, then executes each actual install project with the same limits and /p:BuildProjectReferences=false. This avoids unrelated ALL_BUILD test executables after product dependencies are complete. Process observation confirmed six workers plus the driver, with about 14.9 GiB and 10.7 GiB available at the recorded GUI checkpoints. These are discrete machine-bound observations, not a continuous or enforced memory limit or a suitable fixed choice for every computer. Preserve portable settings before either native target because its reset command runs even during incremental installs.
